daily.today_energy: Mercury's vibes are sparking your curiosity today, Sag. You're feeling that magnetic pull to explore something new—lean into it. Your energy is restless but in a good way, like your soul's ready for the next chapter.
daily.love: If you're coupled up, your partner might be picking up on your wanderlust energy. Have that real conversation about what you both need right now. Single? Someone's noticing your glow from across the room, but they're waiting for you to make the move.
daily.career: Your ideas are hitting different today. Don't sleep on that project or pitch you've been sitting on—the universe is basically giving you a green light to share your vision. Trust your gut on creative decisions.
daily.health: Your body's asking you to move today. Whether it's a walk, dance session, or gym sesh, channeling that restless energy into movement will ground you. Stay hydrated and listen when your energy dips—rest is productive too.

weekly.overview: Your cosmic energy is asking you to slow down and listen to what your intuition's been whispering. This week invites reflection over action—think of it as recalibrating your internal compass before the next big move.
weekly.love: Whether you're coupled up or flying solo, there's a softness in the air around your heart space. If you've been holding back from being vulnerable, this is your gentle nudge to let someone see the real you.
weekly.career: Your professional vibe is less about hustle and more about alignment right now. Trust that the moves you're making are building toward something solid, even if the progress feels quiet or behind-the-scenes.
weekly.health: Your body might be asking for more rest than usual—listen to that. Consider this week an invitation to check in with your energy levels and do things that genuinely feel nourishing, not just productive.
